## About
SO-CAL Speed Shop started on the day Alex Xydias was discharged from the Army Air Corps, when he used some borrowed money to open the first shop on Olive Avenue in Burbank. The hot rods that wore the So-Cal logo ran in pretty fast company.
Today our headquarters is in San Dimas, where we sell hot rod parts, front and rear end kits, early Ford brake kits, Vintique Ford reproduction parts, and SO-CAL clothing and memorabilia. One reviewer put it simply: a timeless hot rod parts business and a great place to buy hot rod stuff.
We're rated 4.8 from 76 Google reviews. Call the sales line with parts questions, or come by during the week and talk cars with us.

## Services
- Front end kits: SO-CAL front end kits and components for hot rods and street rods.
- Rear end kits: SO-CAL rear end kits and components.
- Early Ford front brake kits: Front brake kits and components for early Ford builds, with install instructions on our help desk.
- Vintique Ford reproduction parts: A full selection of Vintique Inc. Ford reproduction parts.
- Clothing and memorabilia: Tees, hats, sweatshirts, signs, patches, mugs and other collectibles.
- Auto storage: Our San Dimas headquarters offers auto storage. Give us a call to ask about it.

## FAQ
Q: How can I place an order?
A: You can order online, call our sales line, email your order, or mail it in with a U.S. Postal Money Order to our San Dimas sales department.

Q: Which cards do you take online?
A: Online you can pay with Visa, MasterCard, Discover or PayPal.

Q: How soon will my order ship?
A: Orders are processed Monday through Friday during business hours, and we generally ship within one to two business days once your order is processed.

Q: Do you have install instructions?
A: Yes. Our help desk has install guides for parts like radius rod kits, front brakes, shock mounts, brake lines and steering stabilizers.
